detail: metric p.10: Moldova is among the top 10 countries for accessibility and affordability of Gigabit Internet, at about EUR 15 a month.
metric p.10: Internet use is 74.7% among women and 72.6% among men, a 2.1-point difference.
finding p.10: Internet access is relatively affordable and its use is widespread.
finding p.21: Moldova's Internet coverage, quality, affordability and penetration indicators are good for its region and income class.
metric p.21: EGA survey: people aged 18-29 used e-services almost five times more often than those aged 60-74; men about 10% more than women.
metric p.25: More than three in four citizens used the Internet in 2022, and mobile connections exceed the population.
finding p.25: Adequate high-speed home broadband access is still a challenge in specific areas.
metric p.25: 4G and fibre coverage is 98 per cent; the 2021 national survey found 34 per cent of the unconnected cite cost as the main impediment.
intervention p.26: Promote the digital agenda as a productive investment: digital services need initial investment but then cost less per citizen.
intervention p.31: Citizens will own their most important data and be able to see logs of who viewed or changed it and when.
intervention p.31: Digitising public services will include reviewing procedures so that only essential information is gathered, not paper forms copied online.
intervention p.31: Services will become proactive: entitlements will mostly be assigned automatically, without forms.
intervention p.31: Reduce administrative burden through digitalised systems: authorities entitled to information should query a register rather than the citizen or company.
intervention p.35: Join international networks, focusing on the EU Digital Agenda, and integrate gradually into all major digital projects.
finding p.39: EGA is responsible for implementing policies on digital transformation, modernisation of government services and ICT use in government.
intervention p.40: The shared digital units will help implement digital-by-default, secure-by-design, once-only and unified service design principles.
barrier p.48: Risk rated high: institutional resistance to digital transformation reforms may affect institutions' digital transformation.
